name: speak of my sin
detailed_description:
Discord:

With the help of the inspector, you are expected to unravel the mysteries and cases of both recent and old years, and then recall and speak out your sins as you get closer to the truth of the story.

In this game, you have three goals:

The fundamental and most important thing is to extract key information to find the truth of the case through the text description searched by the police department.

Each piece of information can be a key clue to the real killer, including the layout of the room at the scene of the crime, the footage from surveillance cameras, the chat logs of the suspect and so on.

The core task [/u] is to connect the facts of multiple cases and restore the whole story. In this game, figuring out the story behind the case is more important than finding out the real killer.

If you encounter difficulties in a certain chapter and can’t find out the truth, please be patient and move on to the next chapter, the answer may be concealed in it.

Characteristics of the Game

  • Complicated plots
    In the game, everyone has their own purpose and hidden story, they cross together for their own purpose, forming a chaotic chess game. But these complex stories are not meant to challenge the player's intelligence, each character in the game has his own beliefs and dreams, abide by his own code of conduct, I will try to make them into flesh and blood.

  • Immersive character experience
    In order to make the main characters more realistic, there are fewer characters in the game than in other games in the genre, which makes the game less difficult.

  • Strong Sense of Substitution
    Although the background of this game is in a virtual world, there are many parallels and similarities with real life. I hope that the human behavior of the characters in the story will make the player feel more involved.

  • Low Difficulty of Reasoning
    Compared with games of the same kind, the answers of the game will have more obvious hints and clues, and the suspects' methods of crime are not sophisticated and complex. And inside the game, even if the answer is wrong, it does not delay the continuation of the story.

I'm sorry that you can't see the English localization on the display of the game screen, because our English translation is not that fast, but I promise that English localization will be added to the final product.

If this game has caught your interest, please also help me add a wish list, it is very important to us.

short_description: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
